data.long_meaning: The name Satisha is derived from the Sanskrit word Satya, meaning 'truth'. In Hindu mythology, Satisha is an epithet for the Hindu goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom. The name is also associated with the planet Saturn, which is considered to be a symbol of truth and stability in Hindu astrology. The name Satisha carries the meaning “Truthfulness, Saturn” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Satisha usually hope their child will grow to embody truthfulness, saturn and live with faith, good character and purpose.
